EV-01

停滯逾一年案件，約六週取得三筆正式訂單Three Signed Orders in About Six Weeks

成機工業｜海外設備銷售Cherng-Ji | Overseas Equipment Sales

事實界線：Evidence boundary: 已回簽訂單；不代表三台設備評估案也已成交。Signed orders. This is separate from the three-machine evaluation, which was not recorded as a sale.
